title: Characterization of Frame-Related Sequences on Semi-Hilbert Spaces
summary: Let $A\in\mathcal{B}(H)^+$ and $B\in\mathcal{B}(\ell^2)^+$ be positive bounded operators. We investigate reduced weighted adjoints of densely defined closable operators and use them to develop frame-type systems in the semi-Hilbert spaces induced by $A$ and $B$. Closedness, boundedness, range behavior, and algebraic properties of the $A$-adjoint are established, with particular attention to sums, products, and double adjoints in the unbounded setting.
